question: How can I customize the introduction text that appears at the beginning of my SDK's README file?
ground_truth: To customize the introduction text at the beginning of your SDK's README, you can set the `introduction` field in the `readme` section of your `generators.yml` file. For example: `introduction: "Welcome to our API"`. This custom text will appear at the beginning of the generated README file.

metadata.cited_context: By default, Fern generates the README automatically with usage examples and API details. Although each SDK has its own README, the content can be configured globally through the `readme` section in the `generators.yml` file. The `introduction` field is described as "Custom introduction text that appears at the beginning of the README" and is an optional string parameter.
